blocks.text: A. Structural Isomerism

Structural isomerism sirf hydrocarbons tak mehdood nahi. Asal mein organic compounds ki tamam classes aur un ke derivatives structural isomerism dikhate hain. Structural isomerism molecule ke andar atoms ki tarteeb ke farq se paida hoti hai. Yeh paanch tarah ki hoti hai.
1. Chain Isomerism
Yeh isomerism carbon chain ki shakal ke farq se paida hoti hai (seedhi chain ya shaakh wali chain). Maslan pentane (C₅H₁₂) aur butane (C₄H₁₀) ki yeh tarteebein mumkin hain.

blocks.alt: Chain isomers: butane aur 2-methylpropane (isobutane); pentane, 2-methylbutane (isopentane) aur 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane), condensed formulae, shakhen zanjeer ke neeche ya oopar.
blocks.caption: Chain isomers (kitab ke safha 266 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 2. Position Isomerism

Yeh isomerism carbon chain par aik hi functional group ki jagah (position) ke farq se paida hoti hai; carbon atoms ki tarteeb wahi rehti hai. Maslan chloropropane aur butene (C₄H₈) ke do do positional isomers hain.

blocks.alt: Position isomers: CH3-CH2-CH2-Cl (1-chloropropane) aur CH3-CH(Cl)-CH3 (2-chloropropane); CH3-CH2-CH=CH2 (but-1-ene) aur CH3-CH=CH-CH3 (but-2-ene).
blocks.caption: Position isomers (kitab ke safha 267 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein but-2-ene ‘CH₃–CH–CH=CH₃’ chhapa hai (double bond aakhri CH₃ par, jo mumkin nahi). Sahi CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃ hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.
3. Functional Group Isomerism

Jin compounds ka molecular formula aik ho magar functional groups alag hon, woh functional group isomerism dikhate hain. Maslan C₂H₆O formula wale do compounds hain jin mein atoms ki tarteeb alag hai: methoxy methane (ether) aur ethanol (alcohol).

blocks.alt: C2H6O ke functional group isomers: H3C-O-CH3 (methoxy methane) aur H3C-CH2-OH (ethanol).
blocks.caption: Functional group isomers (kitab ke safha 267 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 4. Metamerism

Yeh isomerism functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem (batwaare) se paida hoti hai. Aise compounds aik hi homologous series ke hote hain. Maslan ethoxy ethane (diethyl ether) aur methoxy propane.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke matn mein misal ‘diethyl ether and methoxy methane’ di gayi hai. Methoxy methane ka formula C₂H₆O hai aur diethyl ether ka C₄H₁₀O, is liye yeh metamers nahi ho sakte. Kitab ki apni drawing wali sahi jori ethoxy ethane (diethyl ether) aur methoxy propane hai, dono C₄H₁₀O.
C₅H₁₀O formula wale ketone ke do metamers mumkin hain.

blocks.alt: Metamers: H3C-H2C-O-CH2-CH3 (ethoxy ethane) aur H3C-O-CH2-CH2-CH3 (methoxy propane); H3C-H2C-C(=O)-CH2-CH3 (3-pentanone) aur H3C-C(=O)-CH2-CH2-CH3 (2-pentanone), C=O oopar ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Metamers (kitab ke safha 267 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 3-pentanone ka naam ‘3-Pentanonone’ chhapa hai; sahi naam 3-pentanone (pentan-3-one) hai.
5. Tautomerism

Yeh isomerism aik hi molecule mein proton (H⁺) ke aik atom se doosre atom par khisakne se paida hoti hai. Yeh aam taur par amino acids mein nazar aati hai. Amino acids zwitterions ki shakal mein hote hain, jo tab bante hain jab proton amino acid ke carboxylic acid wale sire se amine group par chala jata hai.

blocks.alt: Amino acid R-C(H)(COOH)-NH2, N ke lone pair se COOH ke H tak curly teer, zwitterion R-C(H)(COO-)-NH3+ ke saath equilibrium mein.
blocks.caption: Tautomerism: amino acid aur zwitterion (kitab ke safha 267 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har jore ka molecular formula aik hai magar atoms ki tarteeb alag hai. Tautomerism mein COOH ka H⁺ NH₂ par chala jata hai: COO⁻ aur NH₃⁺ bante hain, aur molecule par dono charges hote hue bhi kul charge zero rehta hai (zwitterion).
B. Stereoisomerism

Stereoisomers aise compounds hain jin ka structural formula aik hi hota hai magar aik jaise groups space mein alag jagahon par hote hain. Yeh class 12 ke syllabus ka hissa hai aur wahan parhaya jayega.
Stereoisomerism ki do qismein hain:

blocks.caption: Isomerism ki qismein
rows: functional group ke dono taraf carbons

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Structural isomerism: chain (butane / isobutane), position (1- / 2-chloropropane, but-1-ene / but-2-ene), functional group (ethanol / methoxymethane), metamerism (ethoxyethane / methoxypropane, pentan-2-one / pentan-3-one), tautomerism (amino acid / zwitterion).
Stereoisomerism: aik structural formula, space mein alag tarteeb; geometrical (cis-trans) aur optical, class 12 mein.
